description: This file defines the 'Province' entity class for the OrangeHRM system, mapping to the 'hs_hr_province' database table using Doctrine ORM annotations. It includes properties for id, province name, province code, and country code, along with getter and setter methods for each property.

classes.name: Province
classes.description: Entity class representing a province, with ORM mappings and properties for id, province name, province code, and country code, including getter and setter methods.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the province entity.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the province entity.

methods.name: getProvinceName
methods.description: Returns the name of the province.

methods.name: setProvinceName
methods.description: Sets the name of the province.

methods.name: getProvinceCode
methods.description: Retrieves the code of the province.

methods.name: setProvinceCode
methods.description: Sets the code of the province.

methods.name: getCountryCode
methods.description: Returns the country code for the province.

methods.name: setCountryCode
methods.description: Sets the country code for the province.
